marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 20 knots except light in Prince Albert Sound.
Wind diminishing to northeast 15 near noon Wednesday then increasing to
northeast 15 to 20 early Wednesday evening. Scattered flurries. Visibility 1 mile or less in
flurries. Temperatures minus 1 falling to minus 6 Wednesday
evening. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre except less than 1 in Prince Albert Sound tonight
and Wednesday morning.<br/>
